What if you cracked your back every single day?
It feels amazing, and lots of people do it every morning. That pop is just gas bubbles bursting in the fluid around your joints. It's the same thing that happens when you crack your knuckles.

But here's the twist. Doing it gently is usually harmless, but forcing it over and over can stretch the ligaments and make joints less stable. And if you feel the urge all the time, tight muscles might be the real problem. Doctors say stretching and moving more often can help, and pain is a sign to stop.
